{{short description|Scottish mathematician}}
{{Other people|Edwin Maxwell}}

'''Edwin Arthur Maxwell''' (12 January 1907 – 27 August 1987) was a Scottish mathematician, who worked at [[University of Cambridge|Cambridge University]] for most of his career.  Although his contributions to original research were limited, his main contribution was in the area of mathematical education,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.icmihistory.unito.it/portrait/maxwell.php|title = The First Century of the International Commission on Mathematical Instruction (1908-2008) - History of ICMI}}</ref> including his 1959 work ''[[Fallacies in Mathematics]]''. His doctoral supervisor was [[H.F. Baker]]. He was president of the [[Mathematical Association]].

He is buried in the [[Ascension Parish Burial Ground|Parish of the Ascension Burial Ground]] in Cambridge.
